motivo: Synthetic example included for local testing only.
testo_ottimizzato: I volunteered at a community garden because I wanted to meet new people. On my first day, I found a box labeled for emergencies only. Inside was a note asking whoever found it to water one forgotten plant. I did, and a week later the garden coordinator thanked me for noticing. It turned out the small plant was a memorial that everyone thought had been lost.
